mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS trend and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC between UNRATE change and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based consumer demand collapse, which triggers a recessionary expectation and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline by > 2% from their 3-month prior values, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls by more than 1.5% in a single month, it signals an imminent manufacturing supply shock that disrupts corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls > 1.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC between INDPRO decline and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPI) over the past 3 months signals rising inflation expectations that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of periods where CPIAUCSL has increased by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC between CPI trend and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls decline by more than 50,000 jobs over a 3-month period, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS falls > 50,000 in 3 months, or the Rank IC between PAYEMS change and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS has increased by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC between RSAFS trend and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a severe manufacturing slowdown that triggers a bearish market reaction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and SPX returns is below 0.03.
